scope: Callable shape of exact reviewed browser method bridges between prepared same-application windows
mechanism: The bridge is an object method. Only own name and length data descriptors from its canonical method are copied; accessor descriptors are never invoked. Stable identity and owning-engine argument marshalling are unchanged.

checks.browser: Chromium and Firefox: production fixture and both string controls passed

assertions: name and length descriptor equality with native method contract
Reflect.construct with bridge as newTarget throws TypeError
existing child listener delivery, synchronous cancellation and explicit removal
limits: No constructor, arbitrary callable or unclaimed native-method adaptation was added. Full application and confinement qualification were not run.
